name: Curled pondweed
note: Curled pondweed (Potamogeton crispus; docs 10, 12, 13; M2): the minnows' gift, an underwater meadow. It never starts on the island and never comes by itself (not in growth.json starters or volunteers): it is planted from the seed the minnows give. habitat, growth, dormant, spread and starter work as in lilies.json: still fresh water deeper than lilies like, on a soft floor. It has no flowering window (its small flower spikes are not drawn). Shape (src/shaders/flora-pondweed.wgsl): a plant is stemsPerPlant stems (more as it grows) rooted within spreadRadius of its center, each rising toward the live water surface (the water simulation's depth over the bed) to at most maxLengthM, leaning out up to leanM (shares of its length) and curving up, stopping topClearM under the surface, the young shorter by size; each stem a thin strip stemWidth wide carrying leaves every leafGapM, alternating sides and turning around the stem by leafTwistDeg, each leaf leafLength by leafWidth, its wavy crisp edge waves times along it. Stems sway slowly in the still water (swayM at the top, swayHz times a second, each stem in its own phase). season: albedo of the leaves (linear), the stem darker by stemShade, the leaf tips paler by tipLight (thin leaves let light through: wrap); roughness of the wet leaves. look: rootShade toward the bed, sproutM a seed's shoots, seedStems on a seed, dormantStems and dormantShare when resting in winter, radiusMin a young plant's spread share, pixelWidth the thinnest a stem is drawn (pixels). outputs: cover it gives (fish shelter in it).

phenology.note: each plant keeps its own calendar, offset from the species by up to jitterDays game days either way (hash of the plant id; src/world/growth/phenology.js), so its flowering, seeding and dormant windows (and the willow's leaf-out and leaf fall) do not all turn on the same hour
